exercise_prescription_rpe.name: exercise_prescription_rpe
exercise_prescription_rpe.value: "exercise_prescription"."target_rpe_low" between 1 and 10 and "exercise_prescription"."target_rpe_high" between 1 and 10 and "exercise_prescription"."target_rpe_low" <= "exercise_prescription"."target_rpe_high"

diet_rule_shape.name: diet_rule_shape
diet_rule_shape.value:
("diet_rule"."kind" = 'weekday' and "diet_rule"."weekday" is not null and "diet_rule"."weekday" between 0 and 6 and "diet_rule"."start_date" is null and "diet_rule"."end_date" is null)
        or ("diet_rule"."kind" = 'date_range' and "diet_rule"."weekday" is null and "diet_rule"."start_date" is not null and "diet_rule"."end_date" is not null and "diet_rule"."end_date" >= "diet_rule"."start_date")

nutrition_target_protein_range.name: nutrition_target_protein_range
nutrition_target_protein_range.value: ("nutrition_target"."protein_g_min" is null and "nutrition_target"."protein_g_max" is null) or ("nutrition_target"."protein_g_min" is not null and "nutrition_target"."protein_g_max" is not null and "nutrition_target"."protein_g_min" >= 0 and "nutrition_target"."protein_g_max" > 0 and "nutrition_target"."protein_g_min" <= "nutrition_target"."protein_g_max")

nutrition_target_carbs_range.name: nutrition_target_carbs_range
nutrition_target_carbs_range.value: ("nutrition_target"."carbs_g_min" is null and "nutrition_target"."carbs_g_max" is null) or ("nutrition_target"."carbs_g_min" is not null and "nutrition_target"."carbs_g_max" is not null and "nutrition_target"."carbs_g_min" >= 0 and "nutrition_target"."carbs_g_max" > 0 and "nutrition_target"."carbs_g_min" <= "nutrition_target"."carbs_g_max")

nutrition_target_fat_range.name: nutrition_target_fat_range
nutrition_target_fat_range.value: ("nutrition_target"."fat_g_min" is null and "nutrition_target"."fat_g_max" is null) or ("nutrition_target"."fat_g_min" is not null and "nutrition_target"."fat_g_max" is not null and "nutrition_target"."fat_g_min" >= 0 and "nutrition_target"."fat_g_max" > 0 and "nutrition_target"."fat_g_min" <= "nutrition_target"."fat_g_max")

nutrition_target_fibre_range.name: nutrition_target_fibre_range
nutrition_target_fibre_range.value: ("nutrition_target"."fibre_g_min" is null and "nutrition_target"."fibre_g_max" is null) or ("nutrition_target"."fibre_g_min" is not null and "nutrition_target"."fibre_g_max" is not null and "nutrition_target"."fibre_g_min" >= 0 and "nutrition_target"."fibre_g_max" > 0 and "nutrition_target"."fibre_g_min" <= "nutrition_target"."fibre_g_max")
